text:
maria: AM async — quick standup. did: ran kernel QPS soak against canary, tuned microbatch slotting (~+12% p99), pushed batcher PR. blocker: intermittent KV eviction spike on shard-3 during hour 2 causing 50–150ms p95 variance. today: triage shard, rerun perf with kv-prefetch off. can someone pick up PR review? https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/4821
kevin: looking now, can you paste the perf snippet?
maria: here’s the repro log snippet:
```text
[2026-03-17T09:12:03Z] shard-3 evict: keys=1.2k rate spike
[2026-03-17T09:12:04Z] p95 latency jump 42ms -> 190ms
```
ash: noted. is this only on NVM instance or also on NVMe local?
maria: NVMe local only so far. suspect prefetch + background flush overlap.
noah: @ash i can repro locally, starting a quick run with prefetch disabled.
deploy-bot: canary deploy succeeded: batcher-pr-4821 -> canary-4 (10% traffic).
riley: I’ll review the PR later today, can you add perf numbers to the PR description? :thumbsup:
kevin: also suggest adding a histogram bucket for eviction events so we can alert on it.
maria: thanks — PR updated with numbers and a short explanation of the slotting change. assigning @riley for review. if we can’t stabilize by EOD, plan is automatic fallback to previous batcher.
noah: run started with prefetch off, will post results here.
riley: ack, will look after standup.
noah: run complete — with prefetch disabled p95 stable ~48ms, no evict spikes in 30m window. quick log snippet:
```text
[2026-03-17T10:05:00Z] run(pre=off) p95=48ms p50=12ms evict-events=0
```
maria: solid. next steps: gate prefetch behind shard opt-in flag, open follow-up issue and a rollback checklist. filing now. :white_check_mark:
